title: Exciting updates for Sneaky Sasquatch come to Apple Arcade
summary: Through October 7, Sneaky Sasquatch transforms Subway Surfers+ with the charm and aesthetic of the hit open-world Apple Arcade game.

title: Apple introduces new Mac Studio with M5 Max and M5 Ultra
summary: Apple announced the new Mac Studio, featuring M5 Max and the all-new M5 Ultra, delivering a monumental leap in AI performance and even faster graphics.

title: Apple unveils a more powerful Mac mini featuring the all-new M6 and M5 Pro
summary: Apple announced the new Mac mini with the all-new M6 and powerful M5 Pro, delivering a dramatic boost in performance and more versatility in its supersmall desktop design.

title: Apple introduces M6 and M5 Ultra for a big leap in performance and AI compute
summary: Apple debuted M6 in the new Mac mini and M5 Ultra in the new Mac Studio, providing an extraordinary leap in performance and AI capabilities.

title: Apple announces changes for apps in the European Union
summary: Apple today announced changes to its business terms for apps in the European Union, following close collaboration with the European Commission.

title: Apple opens Advanced Manufacturing Center in Houston
summary: Apple opened its new Advanced Manufacturing Center in Houston, offering free training and educational sessions for small- and medium-sized businesses.

title: Apple Arcade levels up with Block Blast!+ and Art of Fauna: Cozy Puzzles+
summary: Apple Arcade upgrades its catalog of hit puzzle games with Block Blast+ and Art of Fauna: Cozy Puzzles+.

title: Apple, MLB announce September “Friday Night Baseball” schedule
summary: Apple and Major League Baseball unveiled the September schedule for “Friday Night Baseball.”

title: Leagues Cup kicks off tomorrow, August 4, on Apple TV
summary: The Concacaf-sanctioned competition featuring 18 clubs from Major League Soccer and 18 clubs from Liga MX — kicks off tomorrow, August 4, on Apple TV.

title: Apple reports third quarter results
summary: Apple today announced financial results for its fiscal 2026 third quarter ended June 27, 2026.

title: Apple Upgrade launches in the United States
summary: Apple Upgrade — a new hardware leasing program — is now available on the Apple Store online, in the Apple Store app, and at Apple Store locations in the United States.

title: Apple Maps to power navigation experience for Ford UEV Platform
summary: Apple and Ford announced Apple Maps will be integrated directly into Ford’s UEV Platform through the MapKit for Automotive SDK.

title: Major League Soccer returns to Apple TV tomorrow
summary: Following a monthlong break for the FIFA World Cup, Major League Soccer returns to Apple TV tomorrow, July 16.

title: Madden NFL 27 Arcade Edition brings gridiron action to Apple Arcade on August 6
summary: Apple Arcade grows its roster of hit sports games with the addition of EA SPORTS Madden NFL 27 and more coming in August.

title: Apple and Major League Baseball announce August “Friday Night Baseball” schedule
summary: Apple and Major League Baseball unveiled the August schedule for “Friday Night Baseball,” the weekly doubleheader streaming every Friday on Apple TV.

title: Apple scores record 89 Emmy Award nominations
summary: Apple scored a historic 89 nominations across 15 programs for the 78th Primetime Emmy Awards.

title: Apple to increase spend with Broadcom to produce billions more U.S. chips
summary: Apple announced a new six-year commitment with Broadcom to design and produce custom silicon components and cutting-edge wireless connectivity technologies.

title: Apple Creator Studio gets smarter, faster, and more connected
summary: Apple today introduced power-packed updates to Apple Creator Studio, a groundbreaking collection of creative apps.

title: Apple announces changes to iOS in Brazil
summary: Apple today announced changes impacting iOS apps in Brazil that reflect a recent agreement with Brazil’s competition regulator, CADE.

title: Apple unveils innovative features and intelligence experiences across services
summary: With the 2027 software releases coming this fall, Apple is bringing powerful new features to services users.
